## Module Name
A short, descriptive name (e.g. "DORA Gap Analysis")

## Area
Which area does this module belong to? (e.g. FCP, Legal, Cyber, HR)

## Problem It Solves
What specific professional task does this module help with? Who uses it?

## Sample Input
What would a typical user input look like?

## Sample Output
What should the output look like? (Attach a sample if possible)

## System Prompt Draft
Paste a draft system prompt for this module.

## Suggested Output Formats
Which output formats make most sense? (e.g. Executive Summary, Action Plan, Gap Scoring Matrix)

## Jurisdiction / Standards
If applicable, which jurisdiction or regulatory standards does this module apply to?
